topic: Fake QR code stickers at restaurants and parking meters — scanning vs checking (Pete vs Nia)

scenes.narration: A QR sticker drained two thousand dollars at lunch. Case file 0055. Open the evidence.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named detective cash, sharp blue eyes, gray fedora hat, beige trench coat, five o'clock shadow, holding magnifying glass and a manila file folder labeled with dollar signs, detective cash in a noir office holding a magnifying glass over a parking meter with a fake QR sticker on it, comic banner reads TWENTY FOUR HUNDRED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Pete and Nia park downtown and walk to the same parking meter.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man pete and woman nia approaching the same downtown parking meter on a Saturday morning, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Both see a small sticker on the meter reading scan to pay.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, close up of a parking meter with a small QR code sticker reading SCAN TO PAY, both pete and nia leaning in to look, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Pete scans the QR code and lands on a fake parking page.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, pete on a sidewalk holding a phone with a fake city parking website on the screen, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He types his card number to pay just three dollars for parking.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, pete entering card details on a fake parking checkout screen, comic banner reads JUST THREE DOLLARS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Nia spots the sticker peeling at the corner and ignores it completely.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, nia at the meter pointing at a peeling QR sticker with a suspicious frown, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She taps her card on the actual meter screen for three dollars.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, nia tapping her credit card on the real meter touch screen, a confirmation banner reads PAID THREE DOLLARS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Two hours later Pete gets four red alerts on his phone.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, shocked pete at a brunch table looking at a phone covered in red transaction alerts, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Two thousand four hundred dollars was spent at three online stores.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, three online checkout screens stacked together, each stamped APPROVED, comic banner reads TWO FOUR HUNDRED GONE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Nia's statement shows one clean charge for three dollars to the city.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, nia smiling at a clean bank statement showing one charge for THREE DOLLARS CITY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Same meter, same sticker, but only Pete trusted the fake link.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split scene, left side pete with a frozen card, right side nia with a clean bank screen, the same fake QR sticker between them, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Never scan QR stickers in public. Pay at the meter screen. Case closed.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named detective cash, sharp blue eyes, gray fedora hat, beige trench coat, five o'clock shadow, holding magnifying glass and a manila file folder labeled with dollar signs, detective cash holding a magnifying glass over a peeling QR sticker with a giant red X over it, comic banner reads CASE CLOSED, kids comic book illustration
